branch_purpose: Source-reported finite-source acquisition under a supplied hidden triangular-class/degree promise and an exact reset/action/raw-readout/Boolean-query interface. The largest 20-bit raw, 10-bit fiber case correctly predicted 558 of 1,024 states not queried for the new action/readout. Strongest retaining reconstruction used 181 already-paid raw responses, exact canonical identity for six actions and seven readouts, and replayed 1,008 audit rows. It used no new source queries or truth data and matched the online pipelines at 9,599 counted calls across seven cases. The evaluator domains equaling intended fibers is not an acquired physical-domain certificate.
